title: [Upcoming Jam] Host of "Ultimate AI-Powered Game Jam #1" - Let's build together with AI in 72 hours! (Beginner-Friendly)
author: michyox
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/w9js3fj91u7h1.png?width=630&format=png&auto=webp&s=9705805ad130416377829b31bcca5469af058d65

Hi everyone! I'm michyo, a game dev instructor. I've just launched a new game jam on [itch.io](http://itch.io) focused on creative collaboration between humans and AI tools! Whether you are a programmer, an AI artist, or a complete beginner, this jam is all about having FUN and creating something unique.

I decided to organize this jam because I wanted to challenge the status quo in the game dev community. In too many traditional jams, passionate participants are restricted, stripped of their qualifications, or pushed into unranked categories simply for utilizing cutting-edge AI technology. 

I strongly believe that AI is not a shortcut for the lazy, but a powerful catalyst for human creativity, engineering efficiency, and development velocity.

# 🤖 Jam Concept:

Feel free to use AI for coding, asset generation, or brainstorming! This is a safe space to experiment, learn, and push the boundaries of what's possible.

# 🗓️ Event Dates:

Start date: July 3rd 2026  
End date  : July 6th 2026  
Voting end date: July 8th 2026

# 🎨 Friendly Environment:

I believe that every complex technology starts from a pure feeling of "having fun". Let's support each other and celebrate our creations together!

# 🎫 Join us here:

[https://itch.io/jam/ultimate-ai-powered-game-jam-1](https://itch.io/jam/ultimate-ai-powered-game-jam-1)

# 📢 A little honest note from the host:

As you might know, itch.io experienced a major 7-hour outage earlier today. Because of this chaos, it's my very first time hosting a game jam, but my jam hasn't been listed on the official itch.io jam calendar or directory yet... 😭

If you support the idea of an AI-friendly creative space, could you please check out the link, join the jam, or give this post an upvote to help other devs find us? I would truly appreciate your help to get this small community started! 🥤🤖
